3821-7546-8208.easyPrerequisites:
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{R}.
Inspired Skypainter is prepared.
3821-7546-8208.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Maestro's Gift by paying {3}{U}{R}, targeting Peregrine Drake.
Codie triggers, copying Maestro's Gift, targeting Inspired Skypainter.
Resolve the copy of Maestro's Gift, creating a token copy of Inspired Skypainter with haste
When the Inspired Skypainter token enters, it triggers, causing it to become prepared.
Resolve the original Maestro's Gift, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake with haste
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.

222-527-5256-8201.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-5256-8201.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

4311-5078-7292-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2866-4211-4986-8095.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

997-1981-2415-4446.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
997-1981-2415-4446.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Relic Vial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3188-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3188-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1987-4863-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-4863-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
1987-4863-6747.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Revolutionist.
When Revolutionist enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-4863-6747.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

2275-3532-5078-7753.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2173-2469-5220-7452.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1558-2638-4231-5233-6441.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-4231-5233-6441.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

527-7282-7340.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
527-7282-7340.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {5}{G}
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Selvala.
Repeat.

4559-5147-5805-7306.easyPrerequisites: Two or more opponents have lost life this turn.
4559-5147-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
4559-5147-5805-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gev.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2363-5224-7183.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-5412-6662.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5412-6662.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Chocobo Racetrack and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1692-2489-3732-4863.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{R}{R}.
1692-2489-3732-4863.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 1 or greater that can attack and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1692-2489-3732-4863.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}{R}.
Cast Relentless Assault by paying {2}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Revolutionist with haste.
When the Revolutionist token enters, it triggers, returning Relentless Assault from your graveyard to your hand.
Deal combat damage to an opponent. Nature's Will triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Move to your next main phase and repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

804-2228-3108.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Sakashima the Impostor.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2363-2835-5220.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {0}.
Hangarback Walker enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Fecundity.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Hangarback Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Hangarback Walker from your library.
Repeat.

1850-2167-4935.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-2167-4935.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

1085-2292-4053.description:
Cast Chronozoa by paying {3}{U}. It will enter without a time counter on it due to Solemnity.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Chronozoa.
When Chronozoa dies, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself that also enter with no time counters on them due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 2 using a token copy of Chronozoa instead.

413-803-4338.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Arcane Adaptation, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

5078-6289-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
5078-6289-6650.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

539-4657-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Arbor Adherent.
Repeat.

2018-4050--73.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist or undying creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers if it doesn't have a -1/-1 counter or +1/+1 counter on it respectively, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if the creature didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist or undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter or a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Repeat.
2018-4050--73.notes: You must choose a persist or undying creature that does not have flying - otherwise the Luminous Broodmoth triggers do not occur.

1409-2208-5184.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Charming Scoundrel.
1409-2208-5184.description:
Activate Charming Scoundrel by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Charming Scoundrel enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Charming Scoundrel.
Resolve the Charming Scoundrel trigger, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

2724-2963-3217.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Teleportation Circle. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

628-2193-2292.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Chainbreaker.
When Chainbreaker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

1354-2635-3717.notablePrerequisites: Viridian Joiner does not have summoning sickness.
1354-2635-3717.description:
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to its power.
Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by paying a total of at least {5}{G}{G}.
Raggadragga's third ability triggers, giving Viridian Joiner +7/+7 until end of turn and untapping Viridian Joiner.
Resolve Wurmcalling, creating a Wurm creature token and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
Repeat.

1528-2178-4050-5219.notablePrerequisites: Dual Casting and Thornbite Staff attached to the same creature without summoning sickness.
1528-2178-4050-5219.description:
Cast Caberetti Charm by paying {R}{G}{W}.
Holding priority, activate the creature with Dual Casting and Thornbite Staff attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Cabaretti Charm.
Resolve the copy of Cabaretti Charm, creating two 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Citizen, adding {R}.
The Citizen dies, triggering the creature with Dual Casting and Thornbite Staff attached, untapping the creature.
Repeat from step 2.
